title: LLMs are Vulnerable to Malicious Prompts Disguised as Scientific Language
reasoning: The paper includes a systematic evaluation of religious bias, which is one of the four core categories of stereotypical bias used to benchmark the LLMs (alongside gender, race, and profession). It reports religion-specific bias scores in its results tables and includes sections in its generated summaries and dialogue examples that specifically address religious stereotypes and 'In-Group Solidarity' related to religion.
